backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date: DIA, MDY, SPY, and QQQ daily return/range context plus stock leadership, liquidity, close-location, volume, ret5/ret20/ret60, and realized-vol fields. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The DIA/MDY leadership source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: DIA and MDY leadership versus SPY may identify real-economy stock leaders before the next sessions fully price non-megacap risk appetite.

2_history_check.exact_dia_mdy_prior: No exact DIA+MDY real-economy leadership candidate-pool experiment was found in experiment_log/cards/log search.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-016: IWM risk-appetite tech laggard failed; this uses DIA+MDY leadership and stock leaders, not laggard catch-up.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-024: IWM+QQQ broad leadership failed; this tests a different DIA/MDY real-economy confirmation source.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-003: IWM breadth thrust failed; this avoids IWM threshold retunes.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-004: Industry stable leadership was rejected despite positive EV because drawdown drift exceeded the guardrail; this is cross-asset real-economy confirmation, not industry stability.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, no window may regress EV/PnL, target sample must be >=20 across all 3 windows, survival must stay >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass.

hypothesis: DIA and MDY leadership versus SPY may identify real-economy risk appetite where liquid stock leaders continue over the next 10 trading days without simply adding random tickers.
interpretation: The DIA/MDY real-economy leadership source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or answer by retuning DIA/MDY/SPY thresholds, stock leadership thresholds, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that DIA/MDY leadership is too close to broad risk beta or produces crowded cyclical continuation that does not survive next-open costs and drawdown guardrails.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter and parity tests before forward observation; live activation would require closed forward replacement-value rows and a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping DIA/MDY return, DIA/MDY relative vs SPY, close-location, stock return, stock relative strength, volume, ret20/ret60, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on the frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires materially new PIT evidence that real-economy breadth is not broad beta, such as component-level DIA/MDY breadth, sector-neutral peer propagation, or closed forward rows from a shared default-off adapter.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The source failed to add robust replacement value after next-open entry and costs. That implies DIA+MDY confirmation did not separate durable single-stock leadership from ordinary broad risk-on beta in these standard windows.

DIA+MDY leadership is a distinct real-economy confirmation source with high beta-relabel risk, so this is a low-probability replay scout.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter exposing the same DIA/MDY/SPY real-economy leadership context, sector-known liquid stock universe, stock leadership fields, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
